who: Stephen King, on editor John Gould
quote: This editor was the man who taught me everything I know about writing in 10 minutes.
meaning: Sometimes years of trying wait for ten minutes with the right teacher.

who: Plato (attributed) · Seventh Letter 341c, tr. R. G. Bury
quote: ...as a result of continued application to the subject itself and communion therewith, it is brought to birth in the soul on a sudden, as light that is kindled by a leaping spark...
meaning: After long practice with a teacher, it suddenly clicks, like a spark lighting.

who: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, scientist · India
quote: At 10, Kalam did not understand a 25-minute lesson on how birds fly. His teacher took the class to the seashore to watch sea birds. Within 15 minutes, everyone understood.
meaning: The same lesson, taught the right way, made everything clear.

quote: In 1959, his first season, Sadaharu Oh batted .161. In 1962 coach Hiroshi Arakawa had him lift his front leg like a flamingo. That year he hit 38 home runs to lead the league.
meaning: Three hard years, one coach's small change, and then everything clicked.

quote: In 2015 Ariya Jutanugarn missed 10 cuts in a row. Her coaches had her smile before every shot. In 2016 she became Thailand's first major champion.
meaning: One small habit from her coaches turned fear into wins.

who: Andy Murray and coach Ivan Lendl · tennis
quote: Andy Murray lost his first four Grand Slam finals. He hired Ivan Lendl, who had also lost his first four. In 2012 Murray won Olympic gold and the US Open, and in 2013 he won Wimbledon.
meaning: A coach who had walked the same hard road helped him finally win.

who: Mary Cassatt, painter, on Edgar Degas
quote: I would go and flatten my nose against that window and absorb all I could of his art. It changed my life. I saw art then as I wanted to see it.
meaning: Finding the right teacher's work can show you who you really are.

who: Su Bingtian and coach Randy Huntington · China
quote: In 2017 coach Randy Huntington rebuilt Su Bingtian's start and arm swing. At the 2021 Olympics Su ran 100m in 9.83 seconds, an Asian record, the first Chinese man in an Olympic 100m final.
meaning: Even a top runner got much faster with the right coach.

quote: As an overweight teen, Neeraj Chopra jogged at a stadium to get fit. A javelin thrower, Jaiveer Choudhary, asked him to try a throw. In 2021 he won India's first Olympic gold in athletics.
meaning: A chance meeting with the right person can start a whole new life.

who: Panipak Wongpattanakit and coach Choi Young-seok · Thailand
quote: Korean coach Choi Young-seok has led Thailand's taekwondo team since 2002. In 2021 his athlete Panipak Wongpattanakit won Thailand's first Olympic taekwondo gold.
meaning: Patient work with the right coach can lift a whole team.
